scope: Passive owner-assisted saved Resource Search/reopen evidence package; no fresh scan trigger
implementationPolicy: --owner-evidence is rebuild-only passive instrumentation. It records already-occurring normal Resource map_search request/result and polls the already-rendering Resource table. It also rejects scan/state-changing commands with OWNER_EVIDENCE_READ_ONLY. It never clicks, searches, starts scans, drives the desktop, invokes the live helper, modifies map rows, or clears recovery state.
